$format: blykker book config v0 — see PLAN.md. Copy this file next to your book's files as book.json, fill in the CHANGE-ME values, then follow `setup` in order.

studio.what: blykker is a configuration-first mod of Blygger Studio, not a separate client. You run stock Blygger Studio and apply this config to it.
studio.download: blygger-worker-VERSION.tar.gz and SHA256SUMS from the release
studio.recommended_mount: a subdomain of its own, MOUNT "" (e.g. book.example.com)

setup: 1. Install Blygger Studio from the latest release, following install_guide: create the D1 database and R2 bucket, set name/account/database/bucket in wrangler.jsonc, route a subdomain with { "pattern": "book.example.com", "custom_domain": true } and MOUNT "", apply migrations, set OWNER_PASSWORD and COOKIE_SECRET, deploy.
2. Optional, for AI-assisted writing ([TK] generation, changelog notes): set AI_PROVIDER_KEY (Anthropic) with `wrangler secret put`, and keep the aiModel* settings below.
3. Sign in once at https://book.example.com/studio to check the password works. You don't need to change any settings by hand, because step 6 applies them.
4. Copy this file to your book's folder as book.json. Set `blyg` to your blyg's URL, and point `password.file`/`password.var` at a local, gitignored .env line holding OWNER_PASSWORD.

5. Fill in every CHANGE-ME: title, subtitle, author, settings.siteTitle/authorName/authorUrl/authorBio, the title page and about seeds. Optional: a cover image (sections.cover.image.file, a portrait JPEG with the title set into it).

6. Run `tools/blykker.py book.json seed`. It creates and publishes the cover, title page, Contents, Preface, Chapter 1, References, Index and About, writes their ids back into this file, and then runs sync.

7. Write in the studio. After changing Contents (adding, removing or reordering sections), run `tools/blykker.py book.json sync` (try --dry-run first). It rebuilds navigation, menus, notes, references, index and the cover's Start reading link.
Conventions for notes, references, index terms and images: PLAN.md, 'Invisible markers'. A worked example is the pilot book's AUTHORING guide.
title: CHANGE-ME Book Title
subtitle: CHANGE-ME subtitle
author: CHANGE-ME Author Name

cover.title: Cover
cover.$image: To use a cover image, rename $image to image, set file and alt below, and put ![alt]({image}) as the first line of seed.

$image_example.alt: CHANGE-ME Book Title, by CHANGE-ME Author Name
